meta_description: 247 Repair Leeds provides reliable handyman services for home repairs, maintenance, and improvements. Same-day quotes available. Call 07540 093462.
hero_eyebrow: Local Handyman — All Repairs, All Hours
hero_subhead: From leaky taps to broken shelves—we handle every job around your home, fast and fairly priced.
services_subhead: Whether it's a quick fix or a bigger project, we've got the skills and tools to get it done right.

services.title: General Repairs & Maintenance
services.desc: Leaking taps, broken door handles, loose hinges, and wall damage. We fix the everyday issues that add up—call us before they get worse.

services.title: Shelving & Hanging
services.desc: Strong, level shelves, mirrors, and artwork hung safely. We use the right fixings for your wall type so everything stays put.

services.title: Decorating & Painting
services.desc: Interior painting, wallpapering, and prep work. We leave your rooms fresh and move your furniture back when we're done.

services.title: Kitchen & Bathroom Work
services.desc: Cabinet repairs, tile grouting, sink replacements, and splash-back fitting. No job too small to do properly.

services.title: Carpentry & Joinery
services.desc: Skirting board replacement, door repairs, fitted wardrobes, and bespoke wooden projects. We work to your exact spec.

services.title: Garden & Outdoor Work
services.desc: Fence repairs, decking treatment, gate fixes, and garden shed maintenance. Keep your outdoor space in good order.

about_pullquote: I fix what's broken, fairly and on time. No surprises.
about_para_1: 247 Repair was set up over a decade ago because too many householders were being left with half-finished jobs and inflated bills. We're based in Armley, Leeds, and we know our city inside out. Every job—big or small—gets the same attention to detail and honest pricing.
about_para_2: Our customers return because we show up when we say we will, explain what needs doing, and get it done without the fuss. We're not fancy, but we're reliable. If something goes wrong, we put it right. That reputation has built us steady work across Leeds, and we're proud of that.
reviews_heading: What Leeds Homeowners Say About 247 Repair

reviews.text: Brilliant service. Had a blocked gutter and a hanging rail come loose. Called in the morning and they were here by early afternoon. Fixed both jobs properly, tidied up after themselves, and charged a fair price. Would definitely recommend.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Used 247 Repair for some painting and shelving work. They were punctual, professional, and the quality of finish is excellent. They took care moving furniture and didn't leave a mess. Already booked them again for more work. Highly recommended.
reviews.author: Jennifer L.

reviews.text: We had some bathroom tile damage and a broken cabinet door. They came quickly, sorted it all out, and the work looks spot on. Good communication throughout and no hidden charges. Best handyman we've used in years.
reviews.author: David M.
